answer: Reaching eligibility takes 30 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone burns for every seat it wants. The ember register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and yarrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 30 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 77 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
